_about: Machine-readable Skyglass design of record for scripts/skyglass_check.py. Derived once from the prose sources named in each section; the checker re-verifies every doc_* field against those sources on every run, so an edit to the doc without an edit here (or the reverse) fails the check. Ids are never invented: each id carries the repository file that already holds it (checked literally), or an id_from lookup that is resolved at run time; an id of null is a record not yet created and is reported as pending. Convention and usage: docs/workflows/SKYGLASS_CHECK.md.

picks.doc_rule: **Pick 1 on every run; tainted runs pick 2.**

doc_aliases._about: Names section 4a uses that are not an item's own name. Every other option name must equal an items[].name exactly. A money alias carries the ruling text that sets its amount, checked verbatim.
